content.description: Hand using socket wrench to push throttle cable out of transmission case

items:
PUSH THROTTLE CABLE OUT OF TRANSMISSION CASE
Using a 10-mm socket, push the throttle cable out.

content.description: Hand installing throttle cable into transmission case with valve body nearby

items:
INSTALL CABLE IN TRANSMISSION CASE
Be sure to push it in all the way.

content.description: Throttle cable detail showing rubber boot, painted mark, and outer cable with measurement specifications

content.text: IF THROTTLE CABLE IS NEW, PAINT MARK ON INNER CABLE
NOTE: New cables do not have a cable stopper installed. Therefore, to make adjustment possible, paint a mark as described below.

items: (a) Pull the inner cable lightly until slight resistance is felt, and hold it.
(b) Paint a mark as shown, about 4 mm (0.16 in.) in width.
(a) Connect the cable to the throttle linkage.
(b) Connect the cable housing to the bracket on the valve cover.

content.description: Hand connecting throttle cable to throttle linkage in engine compartment
Parking lock pawl assembly inside transmission showing bracket and bolts

items:
REMOVE PARKING LOCK PAWL BRACKET
Remove the two bolts and the bracket.
